title: Context engineering
summary: Context engineering selects the instructions and evidence available to the model at each step.
overview: Context includes tool definitions, retrieved material, conversation history, and current task state. Retrieval, trimming, and compaction determine what fits and what remains visible.
why: More input can add irrelevant or stale material while increasing cost and latency.
example: A debugging agent loads the failing stack trace and relevant module first, then retrieves callers only when needed.
judgment: Decide which constraints must survive compaction and which evidence the agent can retrieve later.
next: What important constraint disappears first when we compact a long debugging session?

sources.title: Effective context engineering for AI agents
